details:
This update for libarchive fixes the following issues:

- Fix creation of temporary files in target directory (bsc#1254340)
- Fix out-of-bounds buffer overrun when using p[H_LEVEL_OFFSET] (bsc#1254341)
- Fix buffer overrun in archive_le32dec when reading truncated 7zip headers (bsc#1254342)
- Fix NULL pointer dereference in archive_acl_from_text_w() (bsc#1260998)
- Fix SEGV in check_7zip_header_in_sfx via ELF offset validation (bsc#1260999)
- Fix out-of-bounds access on ELF 64-bit header (bsc#1261000)
- Fix RAR5 memory leak with many filters (bsc#1261002)
- Fix file descriptor leak in mtree parser cleanup (bsc#1261003)
